checked_profile.scope: Selected product features and conditions from the provider sources below. This is not a personalized offer, approval decision, or complete fee or policy schedule.

facts.label: Name change
facts.text: The company identifies Happen Bank as formerly LendingClub and dates the rebrand to June 2026. This existing URL is retained to help readers recognize the same provider.

facts.label: Amounts and terms
facts.text: The current product disclosure lists $1,000–$75,000 and 24–84 months. State, product and application-channel restrictions can apply.

facts.label: APR and origination
facts.text: The disclosure dated July 6, 2026 lists 5.96%–35.96% APR and a 0%–8% origination or processing fee. Your offered terms are determined at application; the lowest rate is not guaranteed.

facts.label: Credit check
facts.text: Checking rates uses a soft inquiry. The provider says a hard inquiry appears if and when a loan is issued.
